name: Design
oneLiner: Write the specs, AGENTS.md, and the docs rules before the build.
goal: Leave rules a later agent can follow without the conversation that produced them.

steps.title: Write the specs
steps.text: Name the stack, the documents this stage produces, and the behavior that is easy to simplify away.

steps.title: Write AGENTS.md
steps.text: Fill AGENTS.md from the template so the next agent can start from it.

steps.title: Record durable rules
steps.text: Put rules that must outlive the chat under docs/, and paste the official docs they rely on.

doneChecks.text: The specs name the stack, the documents, and the rules that outlive the chat.
AGENTS.md exists and points at those rules.
Durable rules live under docs/, with official links for the APIs they rely on.

pitfalls.text: Leaving a rule only in the chat, where the next agent cannot read it.

quotes.text: Design produces specs, AGENTS.md, and docs/.

optionGroups.label: Stack
optionGroups.help: Which stack should the agent follow?

options.label: Vue and C#
options.detail: Vue 3 with TypeScript and Vite, plus an ASP.NET Core minimal API.
options.promptFragment: Stack: Vue 3 with TypeScript and Vite, and an ASP.NET Core minimal API in C#. Vue: https://vuejs.org/guide/introduction.html. Vite: https://vite.dev/guide/. Minimal APIs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/fundamentals/minimal-apis/overview?view=aspnetcore-10.0.

options.label: Vue
options.detail: A Vue 3 application, with no API in this change.
options.promptFragment: Stack: a Vue 3 application with TypeScript and Vite. Vue: https://vuejs.org/guide/introduction.html. Vite: https://vite.dev/guide/.

options.label: C#
options.detail: An ASP.NET Core minimal API, with no web UI in this change.
options.promptFragment: Stack: an ASP.NET Core minimal API in C#. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/fundamentals/minimal-apis/overview?view=aspnetcore-10.0.

options.label: Other
options.detail: Use the stack named in the intent.
options.promptFragment: Stack: use the languages and frameworks named in the intent. Paste the official documentation for each one before relying on an API.

optionGroups.label: AGENTS.md
optionGroups.help: Generate a new AGENTS.md, or keep the one already in the repo?

options.label: Generate AGENTS.md
options.promptFragment: Write AGENTS.md for this project. Start from the starter file templates/AGENTS.md and fill it from the decisions in this prompt.

options.label: Use the existing AGENTS.md
options.detail: Read the file that is already in the repo.
options.promptFragment: AGENTS.md already exists. Read it and follow it. Change it only where this prompt names a rule that is wrong.

optionGroups.label: Rules
optionGroups.help: Skip this when the intent already names the rules.

options.label: Official docs
options.detail: Paste a link before relying on an API.
options.promptFragment: Rule: paste the official documentation link before relying on an API. Do not cite blog posts for technical claims.

options.label: Plan before code
options.detail: Correct the plan before application code.
options.promptFragment: Rule: correct the plan before writing application code. Wait until the plan is accepted.

options.label: Narrow layout
options.detail: Usable at about 540px, with the detail region at half the page.
options.promptFragment: Rule: keep the UI usable at about 540px wide, with no horizontal scrolling. The detail region defaults to half the page: the right half from 960px up, and a bottom sheet below that.

options.label: Dark chrome
options.promptFragment: Rule: keep the application chrome on a dark theme. A visual style previews another look and does not restyle the chrome.

options.label: Content as data
options.detail: Options and styles are files, not code.
options.promptFragment: Rule: stages, template indexes, prompt options, and styles are data. Add an option or a style by editing content, not application code.

options.label: Done-checks on the pull request
options.detail: Every pull request names its checks.
options.promptFragment: Rule: every pull request lists its done-checks and how they were verified.

options.label: Docs rule
options.detail: Start a durable rule from the template.
options.promptFragment: Add a durable rule under docs/. Start from the starter file templates/docs-rule-example.md and fill it from this project.

optionGroups.label: Visual style
optionGroups.help: Pick one or more looks. The first look is the primary system and later looks are accents. Skip this when the change has no UI.
